# 2 Baruch Chapter 56 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**56:1** "For-the-first-black-waters which-you-saw coming-from-the-great-sea and-descending-upon-the-earth:"

**56:2** "these-are the-transgressions-that-Adam transgressed-and-which Eve, his-wife, contrived-with-him;"

**56:3** "for-when he-transgressed, untimely-death-came-to-be, mourning-was-mentioned, affliction-was-prepared, sickness was-created, toil-was-perfected, pride-began-to-come-into-existence,"

**56:4** "the-realm-of-Sheol-began-to-ask-to-be-renewed with-blood, the-begetting-of-children was-brought-about, the-passion-of-parents was-produced, the-greatness-of-humanity-was-humiliated, goodness-languished."

**56:5** "What-can-be-darker-or-heavier-than-these-things? For-when-Adam-sinned and-death-was-decreed-upon-those-who-were-to-be-born, there-was-numbered-together-with-this-also the-multitude-of-them-that-were-to-perish."

**56:6** "But-consider now for-yourself what-Adam-did-to-us who-came-after-him: for-we-have-all-suffered on-account-of-him."

**56:7** "Now-for-this-reason Adam-is-not-the-cause, except-only-of-his-own-soul; but-each-of-us has-been-the-Adam-of-his-own-soul."

**56:8** "But-you-will-say: 'What-then-does-it-profit-a-man if-there-is-to-be-a-judgment after-death, since-we-have-sinned against-the-Judge?'"

**56:9** "Hear-now the-rest-of-the-first-black-waters: after-Adam had-sinned, there-was-a-time-of-sorrow."

**56:10** "And-the-heavens were-moved, and-the-earth shook from-its-place."

**56:11** "And-the-animals-which-were-in-the-garden-of-Eden-fled, and-the-beasts-of-the-field went-into-the-forest."

**56:12** "And-the-angels-of-the-LORD, and-the-powers-that-are-above the-heavens, retreated-from-before the-glory-of-the-LORD."

**56:13** "And-the-stars trembled-at-their-stations, and-the-foundations-of-the-earth shook."

**56:14** "And-the-angels-and-the-powers-of-the-light withdrew-from-their-places, and-the-glory-of-the-LORD went-up."

**56:15** "And-the-darkness-came and-made-its-dwelling, and-there-were-no-more-voices-of-the-holy-ones."

**56:16** "And-all-these-things-came-to-pass because-of-the-transgression-of-Adam, and-the-earth-was-plunged-into-darkness."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
